instruction:
Task: Scroll through the chat history when messages exceed the viewable area.
Expected Result: Older messages become visible as the user scrolls up; newer messages or the input area become visible as the user scrolls down.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: Older messages become visible as the user scrolls up; newer messages or the input area become visible as the user scrolls down.
